note: Both sets cover essentially the same 23 claims and read the values correctly, including the MWK02 oven base cabinet dimensions and the millwork quantities. Set A is slightly more faithful: it keeps the MDF material in the wall base profile claim (as a condition) and binds the accent paint colour to the tag P3, whereas Set B truncates the profile to '4" H x 1/2" THK' and uses the generic entity 'ACCENT PAINT'. Neither set invents values, and both omit the same large block of schedule facts (style/colour numbers, locations, several millwork rows).
remarks: Text layer is column-scrambled (millwork rows and quantities interleaved); the image resolves MWK01/MWK02 row assignment, and both sets match the image. Both sets omit many schedule facts: PT1/PT2 style numbers (FGEEOB412 / FGEEOB1224), GT manufacturer (Fireclay Tile), WB finish and location, GL location (shower surround), P3 colour number 33-14 and finishes, and millwork rows MWK01, MWK03, MWK04, MWB01, MWL01, MWD02. Note P3 is used as the tag for both ACCENT PAINT and ACCENT TRIM PAINT on the page, so tag-only references to P3 are ambiguous.
